newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil slightly firmer with IPE but quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil slightly firmer with IPE but quiet.

text.p: European spot gas oil prices were slightly firmer in line with gains on benchmark gas oil futures while barge and cargo differentials were stable in very quiet discussion, traders said.
The July IPE gas oil contract last traded up 75 cents at $162.75 a tonne
Physical trade was slow as the market awaited fresh direction from the U.S. following Friday's Independence Day holiday.
Prompt delivery diesel cargoes were valued around July IPE +$4, with second half cargoes valued at August IPE +$3.75 cif Le Havre following trade at that level on Friday.
0.2 sulphur cargoes were pegged steady around July IPE +$2 with tightening Rotterdam supply supportive.
On the ARA barge market, recent dollar versus mark strength, though slightly softer today, has limited key German inland demand.
Prompt lifting barges talked July IPE +25/+75 cents a tonne with second half July lifting valued around 75 cents over the July screen, traders said early business was thin.
